about: VYRN: visual and temporal perception of a video or a Paper Cinema timeline (cuts, tracks, contacts, sound onsets, sync)

caps.does: process a video or timeline once (cached by content hash); returns its media id
what is in a processed media, in a few lines
when an event type happens (footstep, cut, sound.onset, motion.freeze …)
how one entity (or one joint) moved over time
is the sound in sync with expected times (a timeline, Sonic's report or an events file); exit 1 if not
independent check of a final render's sound against the film's own picture events; exit 1 on a problem
one frame or crop as a PNG path, to look at only when needed
